verdict.summary: PR #305 at head 149b10b87117400bc7e6c3f20f670eb0bdfe12bf has three blocking documentation and policy inconsistencies.

blockingFindings.title: Legacy provider-takeover requirements remain in the PRD
blockingFindings.details: PRD.md still requires a credential-isolated review takeover in Goals and later specifies a secondary-provider immutable-prompt takeover. Issue #304 requires repository review documentation to describe only the provider-agnostic Autoreview path. Replace both residual requirements with the canonical Agent OS-routed Autoreview contract.

blockingFindings.title: Administrative bypass policy contradicts the recorded enforcement state
blockingFindings.details: The revised branching policy says administrative gate bypass is disabled, while docs/managed-enforcement.md records administrator enforcement as disabled and says automation merely does not use the available bypass. This changes and contradicts the documented protection semantics despite the PR claiming to retain them.

blockingFindings.title: Release-branch rewrite conflicts with trusted project policy
blockingFindings.details: The revised policy allows release pull requests through an unspecified eligible release branch. Trusted .agents/.project/PROJECT.md requires a dedicated dev-to-main synchronization PR. This unrelated rewrite makes the canonical release route ambiguous; restore the direct dev-to-main rule or move an authorized policy change to separately scoped work.
